notes: The larger text in a themed Panel Settings window has come down. The body size was right but everything above it was still climbing at the Control Panel’s rate, so headings arrived several steps bigger than anything the OG panel draws…
The window is much smaller: it opens at 430 by 400 instead of 560 by 520, and can be dragged down to 360 by 300. Content padding, row heights and the gap under the heading are all a step tighter.
The side rail went the other way and is slightly wider at 96px, so the longer tab words sit without cramping.
A size you have set yourself is still kept - these numbers only decide where an unsized window starts.
